title: A Retrospective Study to Assess the Clinical Efficacy and Safety of Trientine in Wilson's Disease Patients
brief_summary: This is a retrospective study to assess the clinical efficacy and safety of trientine in Wilson's disease patients
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of Wilson's disease.
* Male or female patients, aged 3 years to 75 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with comorbidity which is not related to Wilson's disease.
study_population: Patients who had the diagnosis of Wilson's disease
